overview_description.description: Raft is a smart logistics platform that automates the freight process for complete control and visibility. Raft's solution will use artificial intelligence to understand, triage, and act on incoming shipment data, saving HBI’s operators countless hours chasing information, manually keying into systems, and reconciling downstream systems. The platform’s real-time, continuous processing will enable HBI operators to handle shipments more quickly and with more certainty for their customers.

product.name: AP Invoices
product.description: Automates the processing and validation of accounts payable invoices to reduce manual data entry and speed up issue resolution.

product.name: Customs Entries
product.description: Automates extraction, consolidation, and validation of data from customs documents to support accurate and timely customs declarations.

product.name: Operations Automation
product.description: Automates operational workflows such as job creation, bookings, arrival notices, and document triaging to reduce manual tasks and improve process consistency.

product.name: Raft Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI logistics platform that centralizes, extracts, validates, and activates transportation data to automate freight forwarding workflows.
